vulnerability.name: USN-7923-1
vulnerability.description: It was discovered that Qt did not correctly handle certain memory operations. If a user or automated system were tricked into opening a specially crafted file, an attacker could possibly use this issue to cause a denial of service or execute arbitrary code.

statements.status_notes: Qt could be made to crash or run programs as your login if it opened a specially crafted file. Available with Ubuntu Pro.
